name: Wine
description: Guidelines for traveling with wine in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Wine is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule (which means standard 750ml bottles must be checked). Duty-free wine is allowed in carry-on if sealed in a tamper-evident bag.

checkedBag.reason: Wine is allowed in checked baggage. Alcohol content must be under 70% ABV (all wine qualifies).
